releaseNotes: Keeps the hardware-confirmed single large resize handle from 0.12.17
Text block geometry no longer grows downward on every keystroke; automatic growth now happens only when content actually reaches the current block boundary
When automatic growth is needed, width grows first in larger steps while page space remains, then height grows only after real vertical overflow
Text colors are now stored per character while the native BOOX textarea remains the actual input control
With no selection, choosing a color changes only the insertion color from the current cursor onward; existing text keeps its previous color
With a selection, choosing a color recolors only the selected characters
Mixed colors are rendered by a passive color layer while the native textarea keeps keyboard, caret and selection handling
Width and height remain persisted across Text/Pen/Marker/Eraser mode switches
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
